problem: Outbound prospecting, research and personalized email take SDR time.
business_model: AI SDR product, also describes an embedded go-to-market engineering service

technical_complexity.rationale: Wrapper-style email research and sending in 2022; team of 1 listed.

defensibility.rationale: No proprietary data or integration described; many AI SDR entrants later.

market_need_then: No sources dated near the 2022 batch were found; the company only asserts that outbound prospecting and email personalization consume sales rep time.
outcome_analysis: Champ remains active with a listed team of one and no public funding found. Its site markets an AI SDR with claimed open and reply rates, while founder Matt Sun's bio now describes a GTM engineering service, hinting at repositioning, but no dated sources confirm a pivot or outcome.
notes: Do not confuse with Champ AI (Redpoint-led $8.5M seed, May 2026), an unrelated company. The 'legacy-home' site may be outdated. Pivot not confirmed so pivots left empty.
